verdict.rationale: A runtime probe confirms that docs.x.ai/llms.txt is served keylessly and indexes a full grok-bot/*.md section of 21 pages, each fetchable as raw text/markdown. The automated docs-md 404 is explained as a double-.md artifact, so it does not contradict this. Missing for 10: a Grok Bot–specific llms.txt (the file is vendor-wide and titled as API documentation), and any independent or community report of agents actually using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
